title: Podcast EP368: An Overview of TSMC Open Innovation Platform (OIP) event with Aveek Sarkar - Semiwiki
gist: Short podcast writeup in which Daniel Nenni and Aveek Sarkar, head of TSMC's Ecosystem and Alliance Management Division, preview the TSMC OIP event, touching on design productivity, energy/thermal/power efficiency, AI design kits and HBM5 on CoWoS; the page contains only a summary, not a transcript.

insights.claim: TSMC's ecosystem leadership is emphasizing design productivity, energy, thermal and power efficiency as core collaboration topics at its Open Innovation Platform event.
insights.speaker: Aveek Sarkar
insights.so_what: Power and thermal limits, not only transistor density, are now headline priorities for the leading foundry's partner ecosystem.
insights.locator: Daniel and Aveek discuss the TSMC Open Innovation Platform (OIP) event.

insights.claim: TSMC is supporting AI design kits and HBM5 on CoWoS through its OIP partner ecosystem.
insights.speaker: Aveek Sarkar
insights.so_what: HBM5-on-CoWoS enablement signals the next accelerator packaging generation is being readied with partners now.
insights.quote: They also describe support for AI design kits and HMB5 on CoWoS.
insights.locator: Daniel and Aveek discuss the TSMC Open Innovation Platform (OIP) event.

insights.claim: TSMC's OIP ecosystem program is run by its Ecosystem and Alliance Management Division, headed by former Sun Microsystems, Apache Design Solutions, Ansys and Synopsys executive Aveek Sarkar.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: TSMC staffs ecosystem leadership with EDA veterans, reflecting how closely foundry enablement is tied to EDA vendors.
insights.locator: Daniel is joined by Aveek Sarkar
